# Token reference

Every token a theme may set, and what reads it. The authoritative source is
[`src/lib/themes/tokens.ts`](../../src/lib/themes/tokens.ts) — this page is
generated from it, so the two cannot disagree.

## Required

A theme must define all of these in `:root`, which is the only block a theme
declares tokens in — a theme is a single palette, and a dark look is a separate
theme rather than a second block. A missing token is a build error: an undefined
custom property renders as `unset`, which is a transparent surface or invisible
text, not a sensible default.

| Token | Kind | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--background` | color | The page ground. |
| `--foreground` | color | Default body text. |
| `--card` | color | Raised surface: widgets, panels. |
| `--card-foreground` | color | Text on a card. |
| `--popover` | color | Menus, dropdowns, tooltips. |
| `--popover-foreground` | color | Text in a popover. |
| `--primary` | color | The primary action. |
| `--primary-foreground` | color | Label on a primary action. |
| `--secondary` | color | Secondary action surface. |
| `--secondary-foreground` | color | Label on a secondary action. |
| `--muted` | color | Recessed surface: table stripes, wells. |
| `--muted-foreground` | color | De-emphasised text, captions, help. |
| `--accent` | color | Hover/active surface for interactive rows. |
| `--accent-foreground` | color | Text on an accent surface. |
| `--destructive` | color | Errors and destructive actions. |
| `--destructive-foreground` | color | Label on a destructive surface. |
| `--success` | color | Success/healthy state. |
| `--success-foreground` | color | Label on a success surface. |
| `--warning` | color | Warning/degraded state. |
| `--warning-foreground` | color | Label on a warning surface. |
| `--cat-1` | color | Categorical ramp 1 — distinguishes, never grades. |
| `--cat-2` | color | Categorical ramp 2. |
| `--cat-3` | color | Categorical ramp 3. |
| `--cat-4` | color | Categorical ramp 4. |
| `--cat-5` | color | Categorical ramp 5. |
| `--cat-6` | color | Categorical ramp 6. |
| `--border` | color | Hairlines and dividers. |
| `--input` | color | Form control borders. |
| `--ring` | color | Focus ring. Never make this invisible. |
| `--brand` | color | The brand surface — the menu bar, the login page, a marketing panel. |
| `--brand-foreground` | color | Text on the brand surface. |
| `--brand-accent` | color | Accent ON the brand surface — never on the page ground. |
| `--radius` | length | Base corner radius; sm/md/lg derive from it. |
| `--type-sans` | font | UI and body text. |
| `--type-heading` | font | Headings and the wordmark. |
| `--type-mono` | font | Code, terminal output, identifiers. |

## Optional

| Token | Kind | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--brand-cyan` | color | Literal brand colour, for large text and non-text accents. |
| `--brand-teal` | color | Literal brand colour, for large text and non-text accents. |
| `--brand-violet` | color | Literal brand colour, for large text and non-text accents. |

## Never

_None. Every colour the UI renders comes from the active theme, in every
environment._

The check is kept rather than deleted: it is the hook for any future value that
must survive a theme change. It held the localhost menu-bar band until that
treatment was dropped in favour of one consistent look.

## Verified pairs

Computed once per theme, over its one palette. See [contrast.md](contrast.md) for what
to do when one fails.

| Pair | Floor | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--foreground` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Body text on the page. |
| `--card-foreground` on `--card` | 4.5:1 | Text on every widget and panel. |
| `--popover-foreground` on `--popover` | 4.5:1 | Menu and dropdown items. |
| `--primary-foreground` on `--primary` | 4.5:1 | The label on the primary button. |
| `--primary` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | `text-primary` links and emphasis. |
| `--secondary-foreground` on `--secondary` | 4.5:1 | The label on a secondary button. |
| `--accent-foreground` on `--accent` | 4.5:1 | A hovered row or menu item. |
| `--muted-foreground` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Captions and help text on the page ground. |
| `--destructive` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | `text-destructive` error copy. |
| `--destructive-foreground` on `--destructive` | 4.5:1 | The label on a destructive button. |
| `--success` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | `text-success` status copy. |
| `--success-foreground` on `--success` | 4.5:1 | The label on a success surface. |
| `--warning` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | `text-warning` status copy. |
| `--warning-foreground` on `--warning` | 4.5:1 | The label on a warning surface. |
| `--cat-1` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Categorical series label. |
| `--cat-2` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Categorical series label. |
| `--cat-3` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Categorical series label. |
| `--cat-4` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Categorical series label. |
| `--cat-5` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Categorical series label. |
| `--cat-6` on `--background` | 4.5:1 | Categorical series label. |
| `--brand-foreground` on `--brand` | 4.5:1 | The wordmark and nav labels on the menu bar, and the login page copy. |
| `--brand-accent` on `--brand` | 3:1 | Accent headings and rules on the brand surface. |
| `--ring` on `--background` | 3:1 | The focus ring must be visible — this one is an accessibility floor, not a preference. |
| `--input` on `--card` | 3:1 | A form control's boundary against the card it sits on. |

## Styleable surfaces

Beyond tokens, a theme may style these classes, their states, and combinations
between them — nothing else.

- `.mix-app-shell`
- `.mix-menubar`
- `.mix-card`
- `.mix-widget`
- `.mix-page-header`
- `.mix-button`
- `.mix-input`
- `.mix-modal`
- `.mix-popover`
- `.mix-table`
